decisions.decision: Board consensus to change glazing (transparency) in the Village Center District bylaw to at least 35% and no more than 60%.
decisions.quote: board concensus was to change to transparency to at least 35% and no more than 60%.

decisions.decision: A new 8.B. 8) was added to the Village Center District draft: no more than 25% of the first floor of a mixed use building can be residential.
decisions.quote: a new 8.b. 8) was added stating that no more than 25% of the first floor of a mixed use building can be residential.

decisions.decision: Enforcement options for the APD bylaw referred back to the Commission to discuss, including fines as an alternative to the two-year permit bar.
decisions.quote: consider the possibility of other enforcement processes, e.g., fines. commission to discuss.

decisions.decision: Board to discuss the member request that the Board meet four times per month at the March 9th meeting.
decisions.quote: m. allison requested the board meet four times/month. board to discuss at march 9th meeting.
